canonical_title: Emergency control marking for red compartment lighting

versions.title_at_revision: Emergency control marking for red compartment lighting
versions.text:
Standard: When red compartment lighting is used, an orange-yellow, IAW paint color 23538 of AMS-STD-595, and black-striped, IAW paint color 27038 of AMS-STD-595, border should be used to outline functional groups involving emergency controls. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review drawings to verify that emergency controls are properly marked.
(2) Examine the air vehicle and verify that emergency controls are properly marked.
